cards.real: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

notes: P7111e87bf7 G4: Vito's {3}{B}{B} gives YOUR creatures lifelink until end of turn. Big (4) is unblocked, Small (2) is blocked by the opponent's Guard. You gain 4 + 2 = 6 (26) and Vito makes the target opponent lose that much: 20 - 4 combat - 6 = 10. The Guard (no lifelink: it is not yours) gains the opponent nothing; Small dies to it.
